Here are 5 places to visit in Jaipur, numbered in a sensible order: start at Amber Fort in the morning, then work your way into the old city.

Amber Fort: hilltop fort, best seen early.
Nahargarh Fort: city views, good at sunset.
Hawa Mahal: the pink "palace of winds".
City Palace: royal rooms and courtyards.
Jantar Mantar: giant stone sun clocks, right next to the City Palace.
